title: N.C.R.B. (....d.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1994 2.6.19 Over the years in the metro/mega cities as far as the crimes of Counterfeiting and Criminal Breach of Trust are concerned, a declining trend is noticed. Whereas, 'Cheating' continue to maintain its significant presence and it hovers around 26 per cent of the total cases reported in the country. The capital city of Delhi and the commercial capital Bombay share the status in topping the incidence reported under Criminal Breach of Trust and Cheating cases. In this year, 1994 Delhi recorded 1338 cases and Bombay 1243 cases under Cheating. As far as the Criminal Breach of Trust cases Bombay (565) recorded the highest incidence followed by Delhi (527). Of the 1135 Counterfeiting cases reported in the 23 urban mega cities 3 cities viz., Bangalore (367), Jaipur (118) and Kanpur (109) together accounted around 52 per cent of the total cases reported in the above urban agglomeration.
